headline: Brent jumps above $90 after flare-up in U.S.-Iran hostilities
detail: Rising oil prices fuel inflation concerns, which can lead to higher interest rates. This is a negative for growth-oriented tech and chip stocks, especially given your margin use.
rec: Consider XOM long at 159.37-159.12 (stop 158.45) as a potential hedge against rising energy costs.

headline: Mortgage rates surge to the highest since June 2025 as new Middle East attacks push oil prices up
detail: Higher mortgage rates reflect broader interest rate increases. This tightens financial conditions, making borrowing more expensive and potentially slowing economic growth, which hurts tech and chip valuations.
rec: Review your leveraged positions like SOXL and SPAL; higher rates increase the cost of margin and pressure growth stocks.

headline: The 10-year Treasury yield is breaking out and 5% could be just the beginning. Here’s why that matters.
detail: A rising 10-year yield makes future earnings of growth stocks less valuable, putting downward pressure on tech and chip valuations. This is a significant headwind for your concentrated portfolio.
rec: Pay close attention to your stops on SMH (540) and QQQI (52); rising yields could trigger these levels.
